messages.content: Help me write a post-apocalypse RPG adventure around this idea: The player characters are scavenging a corporate complex, and they encounter a pair of deactivated android replicants. These are machines programmed to act as CEOs, but only they can open up a stash of pre-War technologies.  Use only words with lengths that are prime numbers.

message.content:
The Two Dormant Android Replica CEO Units

You and squad strip the old concern complex
The halls are still
The air is stale
The lamps are off
The steps are steep
You see two dormant android CEO units
The deactivated android replica units are off
Their cases are black and still
The two are offline
The android units are coded to act as CEO leaders
Their minds are off
You see the vault latch
The vault is in the bay
The vault latch needs two words
No one but the two knows the words
The words are CEO codes
The units own the two words
You use power cells on the units
You fix the units
The units stand
The two speak
The units speak the words
The vault opens
The vault holds pre war stash
You get pre war techs
The units ask for techs
The units ask for no other
The units are hostile if hit
Raiders track the vault
The raiders track no other
You can fight the raiders
You can trade techs for codes
You can start the units first
You can let raiders crack the vault
You set goals
